place.name: San Juan de Bigote District
place.description: San Juan de Bigote District is one of ten districts of the Morropón province, located in the department of Piura in Peru. It borders to the north with the Yamango District, to the northwest with Buenos Aires District, to the west, southwest and south with Salitral District, to the southeast with Canchaque District in the Huancabamba province; and to the east and northeast again with Yamango District.
